# Jubilees Chapter 39 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 39:1 — "eunuch" vs. "officer" for saris

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "eunuch of Pharaoh" | Literal rendering of saris |
| LOGOS | "officer of Pharaoh" | Project convention: "officer" in married context |
| PNEUMA | "one of Pharaoh's officials" | General rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "officer." Per project convention established in Genesis chapters: saris in a married context is rendered "officer" not "eunuch." Potiphar has a wife, which makes the eunuch reading contextually impossible.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 39:5 — "heart and mind" vs. "thought or deed"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he did not sin in his heart or mind" | Literal Ge'ez dual formulation |
| LOGOS | "he did not sin in thought or in deed" | Renders the duality as interior/exterior |
| PNEUMA | "not even in his private thoughts" | Only the interior dimension |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "thought or deed." The Ge'ez has two terms covering both the interior (heart/thought) and exterior (mind/deed) dimensions. PNEUMA only covers the interior. EMET's "heart or mind" does not clearly capture the interior/exterior contrast.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 39:12 — "hanged on the gallows" vs. "hanged"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "hanged on the gallows" | Explicit; follows the Ge'ez compound |
| LOGOS | "hanged on the gallows" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "executed" | Strips the method |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "hanged on the gallows." The Ge'ez specifies the method of execution. PNEUMA's "executed" is too vague.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---
